_doc: Tuning knobs for the unified improvement Routine (prompts/routine2.md). 'enabled_modes' controls which modes the selector may pick; 'weights' are the long-run share of runs (normalized). A mode with weight 0 never runs on rotation; 'floors' gives such a mode a temporary effective weight when its trigger fires (wiki: unharvested observations >= observations_unharvested_lines AND at least wiki_min_days_between_runs since the last wiki run). systemic-fix self-suppresses when planning/wiki/ideas/backlog-queue.json has no open batch-ready item; candidates self-suppresses while candidate_words.json holds >= candidate_restock_threshold words; accuracy-review self-suppresses when the OpenRouter daily cap is spent. Reweighted 2026-09-02 (enhancement/assessment-2026-09-02.md §6.A3): accuracy and systemic-fix up, new-entries down (internal closure only), wiki trigger-only. Audio added 2026-09-25 (AUDIO_WORKFLOW.md §9): about a quarter of runs record example audio; the other weights scaled by 0.75. Tom raised the daily cap to $7.50 and set audio_session_cap_usd to $4.80 on 2026-09-25. audio self-suppresses while audio/config.json production.enabled is false or less than audio_min_budget_usd of the daily OpenRouter cap remains. conjugation-check added 2026-09-30 (Tom asked for an occasional re-check of the generated conjugation tables): weight 0, trigger-only like wiki, fires once conjugation_check_min_days_between_runs (1 day, about one Routine run in eight) has passed since the last one, at the 'floors' weight; its model pass is capped by conjugation_check_cap_usd. Reweighted 2026-10-23 (enhancement/assessment-2026-10-23.md): 97% of examples were recorded, so audio drops from 0.25 to 0.10 and runs only when at least audio_min_backlog new or stale examples wait (or audio_max_days_between_runs have passed with any waiting), doubled at audio_high_backlog; the freed share goes to polish (0.30), accuracy-review (0.26) and systemic-fix (0.22). conjugation-check moves from daily to every three days: since the Routine went to two runs a day (2026-10-14), a daily check took one cycle in twelve, and 12 of its last 13 cycles changed no entry. Budget split 2026-10-23 (Tom: at most $15 a day): the accuracy reviewer moved to openai/gpt-6.1-sol (about 8x the cost of gemini-2.5-flash), so accuracy-review gets at most accuracy_daily_cap_usd ($10) a day and $5 a cycle; the other $5 covers self-checks, audio (now $2 a cycle: only new and edited examples), conjugation checks and candidate brainstorming. New entries faster 2026-10-23 (Tom): new-entries 0.08 → 0.16 and candidates 0.04 → 0.06 (polish 0.26, accuracy-review 0.24, systemic-fix 0.18); the candidates mode adds a brainstorming stream (build/brainstorm_candidates.py, at most brainstorm_cap_usd a cycle) to internal closure, and restocks below 200 candidates instead of 100.
